title: Unlocking the effect of film thickness on the thermoelectric properties of thermally evaporated Cu2−xSe thin films
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37688-37695
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06908K, Paper

Muhammad Irfan, Sajid Butt, Sumayya, Muhammad Waseem Akram, Muhammad Saadullah, Muhammad Abdul Basit, Jahanzeb Ahmad, Muhammad Yasir, Huma Ozair
The bulk-like thermoelectric efficiency (ZT ≈ 1.2) in Cu2−xSe thin films is aided by a simultaneous increase in the electrical conductivity and Seebeck coefficient as the film thickness increases.
